sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0344: part BR-310; plant TO2; customer CLM; supplier Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri); billet grade EN AW-5083-H111; status APPROVED 2025-06-11 (PPAP-2025-052)
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
Scope: series production parts released at Torino Plant 1 (TO1) and Torino Plant 2 (TO2) for customers Stellantis (STL) and Cantieri Lombardi Mobility S.p.A. (CLM).

findings.why: Meccanica C is approved for BR-310 only at TO2 for CLM. The ASL is complete for TO1 and CLM and lists no approval for BR-310 at TO1, so the proposed Plant 1 run has no source approval. Approval is per part, plant and customer. The Plant 2 line being down does not change that.
